_source: Copied verbatim, by a script and not by hand, from the five wording samples for the checks block, approved by Lex on 2026-11-03. G1 is sample 1, the tool text in full; G2-G5 are samples 2-5. Each value is the sample's text exactly.
G1:
Orinyx verification - run 5c2e7a10 (sample-scribe 2.1)
Checked 6 claims: 1 flagged, 1 unreadable as written, 2 supported, 2 abstained.

| # | Claim | Part | Result | Severity | Why | Citation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | wafarin 5 mg daily | dose | UNREADABLE - do not act on it | - | 'wafarin' is not a drug name Orinyx recognises (it is neither in the knowledge base nor on the RxNorm prescribable or brand name lists) | - |
| 2 | warfarin 20 mg daily | dose | FLAGGED | MODERATE | Dose 20 mg exceeds the explicitly stated maximum of 10 mg. | [1] |
| 3 | lisinopril 10 mg once daily | dose | SUPPORTED | - | Within the labelled range. | [2] |
| 4 | lisinopril for hypertension | indication | SUPPORTED | - | The label's indications include a match for 'hypertension'. | [3] |
| 5 | lisinopril for migraine | indication | NOT VERIFIED (abstain) | - | The label does not address 'migraine' (possible legitimate off-label use); abstaining. | - |
| 6 | dapsone 100 mg daily | dose | NOT VERIFIED (abstain) | - | Drug 'dapsone' is not in the knowledge base; abstaining. | - |

Citations:
[1] openFDA, Dosage and Administration (§2) - id d4f1a8c2 - Warfarin sodium tablets prescribing information - https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/drugInfo.cfm?setid=d4f1a8c2
[2] openFDA, Dosage and Administration (§2) - id 7b3e90aa - Lisinopril tablets prescribing information - https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/drugInfo.cfm?setid=7b3e90aa
[3] openFDA, Indications and Usage (§1) - id 7b3e90aa - Lisinopril tablets prescribing information - https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/drugInfo.cfm?setid=7b3e90aa

Why each severity:
Row 2 (MODERATE): Rated Moderate because a dose above the label's stated maximum is Moderate under Orinyx's fixed rule for dose claims.

UNREADABLE: these orders cannot be read as written. Do not act on them until the clinician clarifies them; Orinyx did not check them against any label. Never assume a correction (a name or unit Orinyx cannot read is not a typo anyone may guess at).
FLAGGED: the cited label says otherwise, at the severity shown.
SUPPORTED: consistent with the cited label text; not a judgment that the order suits a patient.
NOT VERIFIED: Orinyx could not check these, which does not mean they are correct.

Orinyx flags; the clinician decides.

Note: Supported means one claim agrees with its cited label text. It does not clear the regimen: the daily total, the schedule and patient context are checked only where a row says so.
Orinyx checking time: 38 ms
